name: Chengdu Shuangliu International Airport
before:
One of two international airports serving Chengdu, 16 km south west of downtown, and a major aviation hub for western China. The other is Chengdu Tianfu, so always confirm which one an itinerary means.

The airline weight here is considerable. Shuangliu is one of Air China's two core hubs, the other being Beijing Capital, and it is the principal hub and headquarters for both Sichuan Airlines and Chengdu Airlines. China Eastern, China Southern, Shenzhen Airlines, Lucky Air and Tibet Airlines all have bases here too.

Getting into the city is easy. Airport Bus 1 runs to the city centre near the Jinjiang Hotel metro station, Bus 2 to Chengdu railway station and Bus 3 to Chengdu East. There is also a CRH high speed train from Shuangliu Airport railway station.

It is one of the oldest airports in China. Its predecessor, Chengdu Shuangguisi Airport, was built in 1938, and the site has been expanded eight times since. It became an international port of entry in 1993 and took its current name on 30 November 1995.
after:
One of two international airports serving Chengdu and a major aviation hub for western China. It sits 16 km south west of downtown. The other airport is Chengdu Tianfu, so always confirm which one an itinerary means.

Sichuan Airlines has its headquarters at the airport, and Air China and Tibet Airlines also fly from here.

Getting into the city is easy. Metro Line 10 stops at both terminals and runs to downtown Chengdu, and there is also a CRH high speed train from Shuangliu Airport railway station.

Its predecessor, Chengdu Shuangguisi Airport, was built in 1938. It became an international port of entry in 1993 and took its current name on 30 November 1995.

sources.quote: However, on July 30, 2026, most Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan flights were relocated back to Shuangliu Airport following renovations.

claims.why: Held back: the old text does not say where any flights go, so this replaces nothing, though it is the reason behind its 'always confirm' advice. From 30 July 2026, 22 Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan flights by seven airlines (Air China, Sichuan Airlines, Hong Kong Airlines, Air Macau, Cathay Pacific, EVA Air, China Airlines) moved from Tianfu Terminal 1 to Shuangliu Terminal 1, while Air China, China Eastern, Shenzhen Airlines and Tibet Airlines keep such routes at Tianfu (the airport group's notice, Chengdu Daily, Wikipedia). Was to read: "Since 30 July 2026 flights to Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan have used both airports, seven airlines flying them from Shuangliu." Also found but with one source only, so not held: Wikipedia says every other international passenger flight moved to Tianfu when it opened in 2021; none of the operator's or Chengdu Daily's pages read here says so.

opinion.why: The old text's judgement, kept: metro Line 10 stops at both terminals and runs to downtown Chengdu, and the airport has its own railway station (operator, Wikipedia).
